:[Text formatted as a block quote, slight italic and bold emphasis on the words "right" and "exact"]
:"Far better an approximate answer to the right question, which is often vague, than an exact answer to the wrong question, which can always be made precise.

:[Author and source towards the right of the comic below the quote]
:John W. Tukey
:''The Future of Data Analysis'' (1962)

:[Caption below the comic:]
:Happy approximate birthday to John Tukey, author of my favorite statistics quote, who was born 110.000 years ago sometime this week.
